recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a young man with tattoos and a backward cap, framed by a semi-transparent textured banner at the bottom containing thin geometric typography and a circular monogram.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's intense gaze directed at the viewer
Arms raised behind head creating a triangular frame for the face
Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool, dark textured background
Geometric logo acting as a central divider for the text banner
coreInvariants: Semi-transparent grey horizontal banner at the bottom edge
High-detail skin texture and facial hair stubble

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and occupies the top 80% of the frame, cropped at the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the central circular monogram in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the arms down to the tattoos, and settle on the horizontal text banner at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, scratched blue-grey background provides breathing room around the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal grey background with heavy grit texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light grey/white of the subject's t-shirt and the semi-transparent footer banner.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and subtle teal/green hints in the arm tattoos.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright face and dark background; desaturated overall palette with punchy highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a moody, desaturated urban aesthetic

characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular monogram containing interlocking angular initials
Thin black outlines for the circular logo
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A single ultra-light weight used for both text and the internal lines of the monogram.
graphicDevices: Thin black horizontal border lines on the banner
Circular emblem as a focal point

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lines.
Classic geometric proportions that match the 'O' and 'B' shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a tattooed man in a white v-neck and backward cap against a dark, scratched blue wall. Leave the bottom 20% clear for a banner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a semi-transparent light grey banner at the bottom with thin black borders. Place a geometric circular monogram in the center and ultra-light, wide-spaced uppercase sans-serif text on either side.

verificationChecks: Is the banner semi-transparent with a grit texture?
Is the monogram perfectly centered between the two words?
Does the subject have a direct, intense eye contact?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the banner texture.
Verify the arms create a symmetrical frame for the face.
Check that the monogram lines match the font weight.
Confirm the background has a distressed, metallic or concrete feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Textured Lower Third + Geometric Hairline Typography
